# ONNX Runtime

`onnxruntime-node` (MIT, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation) runs the face detection model. Its
npm package carries no licence file, so the licence and the notices for the third-party components
inside its native library are kept here, unchanged, from the
[v1.31.1 release](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.31.1):

- `LICENSE`
- `ThirdPartyNotices.txt`

Update both when the `onnxruntime-node` version changes.
